admission_apply.text: You turn the reed. A dry click answers late, like a missed entrance in a quiet room.

native.admission_inspect: An ivory reed, thumb-worn at one end. The crack does not follow the grain.
apply_texts: Further pressure changes little. The crack keeps its old, exact, unfinished shine.
Nothing on the reed names the omission. The unfinished step simply comes again.
The pale grain shifts. A measure begins, then politely declines to finish.
The reed feels thinner. It offers one spare tone, then the crack goes dull.
The reed is cool and ordinary, until the crack seems to answer a note you did not sound.
The same four notes nearly cohere. They fray before any title can be given them.
Under your thumb a thin tone rises, elegant and brief, and then forgets itself.
You turn the reed. A dry click answers late, like a missed entrance in a quiet room.
inspect_texts: An ivory reed, thumb-worn at one end. The crack does not follow the grain.
Dust lines the crack. Four notes almost gather, then leave only your breath.
The crack has a pale lip now. You keep waiting for a note that does not come.
The reed lies still. Its varnish is even, except where the split is too exact.
The split recurs without a mark to explain it. A half-step stays missing.
native.name: Pale Reed
